long_biography.plain_text:
Prienamed grew from Harald Gumbiller’s aim to bring multiple medical specialties under one roof while combining conventional care with complementary methods. He and like-minded colleagues established the centre in 2001, and he has remained a managing director while practising orthopaedics in Prien am Chiemsee. The centre’s interdisciplinary model joins specialists around integrated diagnosis and treatment.

Gumbiller’s clinical approach centres on conservative care for musculoskeletal problems and looks beyond the painful area for underlying causes. His work has included treating professional tennis, football and ice-hockey players. With fellow physician Dirk Polonius, he also developed MyMineralMix, an individualised supplement service derived from their medical practice and a structured nutritional questionnaire.
